title: ESP training with handler 'Meg' after interns hired
place_text: Baker Victory Services, Western New York

tellings.quote: 2 months later a team of interns get hired and this team of interns specifically work on me in my case.

plain: Jordan Jose, a man who says he was taken into a secret UFO programme as a child, says that around 2008 to 2010 at Baker Victory Services, a children's service in Western New York, a team of interns was hired about two months after he arrived and worked only on him and his case. He says he was trained in ESP, meaning extrasensory perception, the supposed ability to sense things without the normal senses, under a handler he calls Meg. He tells it as his own experience, and if true it would mean a hidden programme was testing children for psychic abilities.
